parameters.content:
## 1. Invites
The recruiter approves candidates in the screener app and clicks **Send invites**. The request is signed, so only the app can start this. Each candidate is held 3 free times and gets an email (test mode: saved to the outbox, not sent).

nodes.name: Check it came from the screener

parameters.content:
## 2. Booking
The candidate clicks a time in the email. The link is signed, so it cannot be made up or changed. The time is booked (test mode: a simulated calendar), a confirmation is written, and if someone took that time a moment earlier, 3 new times are offered.

nodes.name: Book it or offer new times

parameters.content:
## 3. Reminders and follow-ups
Every 15 minutes: a reminder 24 hours before each interview, one follow-up after 3 days without an answer, and a note to the recruiter after 5 days. Nobody is rejected automatically.

## 4. See what happened
**/outbox**: every email and the calendar. **/log**: the audit log. **/reset** (test mode, signed): start a fresh demo.
